verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs explicitly market the 96 GB GDDR7 memory as enabling local LLM fine-tuning and agent workloads, and community evidence (HN thread) shows real users running multi-GPU RTX PRO 6000 setups for high-throughput LLM inference (tens of thousands of tok/s), confirming practical single-node large-model inference. Missing for 10: an explicit published memory-bandwidth (GB/s) figure and a documented single-card 70B-quantized benchmark rather than a 4-GPU aggregate.
